preconditions.description: The number of tournaments n must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of kinds of sports k must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sij <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(k))
preconditions.description: Each power value sij for the sportsmen must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each tournament.
Each line of output must represent a positive integer indicating the number of possible winners.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) <= i + 1 for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The number of possible winners for each tournament must not exceed the number of participants in that tournament.
